title: Thomas Partey booed by Gillette Stadium crowd during game vs. England
content:
Ghana midfielder Thomas Partey was booed by sections of the Gillette Stadium crowd in Foxboro during his nation’s World Cup group-stage game against England.

Partey was charged with five counts of rape and one count of sexual assault in July 2025 by London’s Metropolitan Police. He pleaded not guilty to those charges in September of that year. Partey was subsequently charged with two new counts of rape in February this year, to which he also pleaded not guilty in April. Partey has always denied any wrongdoing and his lawyer has previously said he welcomes the opportunity to clear his name at a trial, which is scheduled for June 2027.

The 33-year-old missed Ghana’s first World Cup game — a 1-0 win over Panama on Wednesday in Toronto — after being denied entry to Canada when his visa application was refused, as exclusively reported by The Athletic. He subsequently failed in an attempt to overturn the denial when he lodged an appeal in a Canadian federal court, after his application falsely claimed that he had not been charged with any criminal offences in any country. It is unclear whether Partey himself completed the application.

The booing happened multiple times in the first half when the former Arsenal player touched the ball.

Partey was eligible to feature against England after previously arriving in the United States without issue. However, if Ghana finish as runners-up in Group L, they will once again play at Toronto’s BMO Field.

Partey addressed the media at a training session in Boston, Massachusetts on Monday.

“I’m OK, I’m feeling good, we’ve been training good,” he told reporters. “Everybody’s ready. We are here trying our best to compete with the rest of the teams. I think preparation is key.”

When asked about missing the first game, he replied: “Well, I think it’s part of football, things happening outside of football that you can’t control. For me now, I feel OK and I’m ready to play.”

Partey spent five seasons at Arsenal before leaving the club when his contract expired in June 2025. He subsequently joined Villarreal and made 32 appearances for the team, though The Athletic reported that the Spanish club do not intend to renew his deal when it expires this month.

Partey has made 57 appearances for Ghana.
